players.bio: Callum Marshall (born 28 November 2004) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Luton Town and the Northern Ireland national team. Early life Marshall was born in 2004 in Glengormley, Northern Ireland. He attended Glengormley Integrated Primary School.
Daniel Lewis Gore is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town, on loan from Premier League club Manchester United.

Devante Lavon Andrew Dewar-Cole is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Port Vale. Cole was born in Alderley Edge on 10 May 1995. His father is Andy Cole. He has stated that he is a different type of player to his father, who played in the same position.

Emilio Alford Anthony Lawrence (born 20 September 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Luton Town, on loan from Manchester City. Born in England, he plays for the Scotland U21s. Club career A product of the youth academy of Everton, Lawrence joined the academy of Manchester City in 2022.

George Johnston (born 1 September 1998) is a professional footballer who currently plays as a defender for League One club Bolton Wanderers. Born in England, Johnston represents Scotland at youth international level.
Gideon Mensah Kodua is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL League One club Luton Town, on loan from West Ham United.
Hakeem Ademola Odoffin (born 13 April 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back, right-back or midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town.

Harrison Ashby is a 24-year-old professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Luton Town, on loan from Premier League side Newcastle United. Born in England, he is a youth international for Scotland. Club career Prior to signing for West Ham United at the age of nine, Ashby was on the books at Chelsea.

Isaiah Benjamin Montell Jones (born 26 June 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a wing-back and winger for EFL League One club Luton Town. Born in England, he represents the Guyana national team.

Jack Andrew Garry Wilshere (born 1 January 1992) is an English football coach and former professional player who played as a midfielder. Wilshere came up through Arsenal's youth academy and impressed from an early age. He made his first-team debut in 2008, becoming Arsenal's youngest ever league debutant at the age of 16 years, 256 days.
Jake Thomas Richards (born 8 August 2007) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town.
James William Shea is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Luton Town.

Jamie Paul Donley is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town, on loan from Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur. Born in Northern Ireland and raised in England, he is a youth international for both countries.
Jayden Luker is a 21-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Luton Town F.C..
Joseph Nathan Johnson (born 21 February 2006) is an English footballer who plays as a left-back for Luton Town.

Jordan Charles Clark (born 22 September 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Luton Town. Clark won Barnsley's 'Most Promising Academy Player' award for the 2009–10 season, and signed a scholarship deal with the club in July 2010. He signed his first professional contract in March 2011, alongside Danny Rose. He made his senior debut for Barnsley on 12 April 2011.
Joshua Keeley (born 17 May 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Luton Town.

Kal Alexander Naismith (born 18 February 1992) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for Luton Town Football Club. A Rangers youth graduate, Naismith made his breakthrough into the first team in the 2012–13 season, after loan spells at Cowdenbeath and Partick Thistle. He has represented Scotland at under-16 and under-17 level.

Kasey Remel Palmer is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town. Born in England, he represented his country of birth up to under-21 level, before electing to play for Jamaica at senior level.

Liam Walsh (born 15 September 1997) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town. He has also spent time on loan at Yeovil Town, for whom he made his Football League debut, and at Birmingham City.
Mads Juel Andersen (born 27 December 1997) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Luton Town.

Nahki Michael Wells (born 1 June 1990) is a Bermudian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Luton Town and the Bermuda national team. Wells began his career in his native Bermuda, playing for Dandy Town Hornets and Bermuda Hogges.
Reuell Joshua Walters (born 16 December 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Luton Town.

Shandon Harkeem Baptiste (born 8 April 1998) is a Grenadian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town. Baptiste is a product of the Reading and Oxford United academies and began his senior career with the latter club in 2017.
Shayden Jermaine Morris is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL League One club Luton Town.
Sverre Hakami Sandal is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Luton Town.

Teden Mambuene Mengi (born 30 April 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Luton Town. Mengi is a graduate of the Manchester United youth system. He made his senior debut for the club in the UEFA Europa League in August 2020. He had spells on loan at Derby County in 2021 and Birmingham City in 2022.
